GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Salts II ● Solubility of salts in water ● Factors affecting solubility of salts .

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin Lenses ● Types of lenses ● Properties of thin lenses (principal focus, opti.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproduction.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproduction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproduction.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human nervous system ● Components of the nervous system in a mammal (Central Ner.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Mole ● Relative Atomic Mass of elements ● Conversions of chemical quantities.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Mole 2.3 Hydrocarbons 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Thin Lenses 3.2 Newto.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
